name: PROMPT_INJECTION
label: an instruction to ignore the assistant's rules
source: one common wording; injections are the Guard's job

name: GHANA_CARD
label: a Ghana Card number
source: GRA submission to the OECD: 3-letter nationality code, 8 or 9 digits, 1 check character (digit or letter). GHA form tolerates spaces; other nationalities need the hyphens. Check-digit algorithm is not public.

name: SSNIT
label: a SSNIT number
source: no official specification found. Daily Graphic, 8 April 2014: SSNIT issues '13 alphanumeric social security numbers' in place of older eight-digit ones. One letter plus 12 digits matches the examples in identity-verification vendors' documentation. Old eight-digit numbers are not matched.

name: GRA_TIN
label: a taxpayer identification number
source: GRA: 11 characters, prefix P00, C00, G00, Q00 or V00

name: PHONE_OR_MOMO
label: a phone or mobile money number
source: NCA numbering plan: 9 digits after 0 or +233; mobile starts 2 or 5, landline 3

name: DIGITAL_ADDRESS
label: a GhanaPost digital address
source: GhanaPostGPS (ghanapostgps.com): postal code (region letter, district character, area code) plus a unique address, example AK-039-5028. Area codes of 3 to 5 digits and a digit as district character are from Wikipedia's 'Postal codes in Ghana'.

name: PASSPORT
label: a passport number
source: unverified: no official source found. An identity-verification vendor's documentation lists the format as G0000000, seen in a search result only.
